summary: QA gate 2 PASS (no blocker). Every automated check is green: typecheck, lint, npm test 76/76 in 5 files, ci:tenant-check, and next build with 26 new dynamic routes. The fresh bootstrap of mahua_qb, seeded twice, matches the sample-data acceptance table exactly and the second run is identical (inquiries 10, samples 3, quotations 4 / items 4, orders 3 / items 3, dispatches 2, payments 4, follow_ups 8 pending + 6 notes). Counters continue at INQ-0011 / SMP-0004 / QTN-2627-0005 / ORD-0004 / PI-2627-0004 / INV-2627-0003 / SDN-2627-0003 / REC-2627-0005. I replayed the full demo-script flow by SQL as sales, owner, accountant and Plant in one rolled-back transaction: 96/96 contract checks passed, the Home numbers moved as flows.md says, and every negative path returned its contract code (42501 / P0001). All 37 unauthenticated route probes redirected to /login with no 500. The jargon audit and label keys are clean. Break attempts found 3 high issues in the DB walls: the floor guard can be bypassed through a currency with no price-list row (EUR is offered in the UI for Rhine) or by changing a draft's currency; Plant can write buyers; rows can reference another org's buyers or products. They also found 1 major issue (quick-made export buyer gets country '', so quotes and orders disagree), 5 minor and 3 info. The signed-in UI walkthrough is blocked on hosted Supabase credentials.

findings.problem: The floor-price guard can be bypassed. (a) If no price-list row exists for the quote currency, there is no floor at all. The form offers the buyer's preferred_currency as a chip, so seeded Rhine shows '€ EUR'. Sales can then save, send and accept any rate; the probe gave ORD-0005 EUR 12.00 for 12 MT, and EUR money is also missing from the Home tile. (b) If a draft's currency changes after its items are saved (USD -> INR), the old floor_price_at_time stays, and fn_quote_send passes at ₹2.38/kg against a ₹175/kg floor.
findings.fix: In fn_quote_item_guard, raise below_floor_price for non-owners when no active price-list row exists for (product, currency). In fn_quote_send, re-derive the floor from the current price list for the current currency. Block or re-validate a currency change on a draft that has items (trigger, or remove currency from the column grant). In the form, offer only currencies that are priced for the product. Add both probes to tests/quotes.test.ts.

findings.problem: Plant is meant to be read-only on buyers (flows.md 11, screens.md 0.1), but only the pages enforce this. The buyers / buyer_contacts write policies and createBuyerAction / updateBuyerAction check only the buyers module, which the seeded Plant user holds. As ops@: UPDATE buyers SET credit_period_days=90 -> 1 row; INSERT buyer -> BUY-0005. Credit days drive due dates and the Late pill.
findings.fix: Treat it like amendment A1. Dev-2: add AND fn_user_role() IN ('owner','accountant','sales') to the buyers and buyer_contacts INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies. Dev-1: add the same role check in both buyer actions. Add a test: ops UPDATE buyers affects 0 rows.

findings.problem: The insert and update policies check only the new row's org_id, and a plain FK accepts a buyer_id / product_id / packaging_type_id from another org. MDPL sales created SMP-0005, QTN-2627-0006 and INQ-0012 pointing at another org's buyer. Org A can pin org B's buyer (B can no longer delete it). A quote item with a foreign product_id has no floor (another bypass). Exploiting this needs a foreign UUID, so the likelihood is low.
findings.fix: Add WITH CHECK sub-selects such as (buyer_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM buyers b WHERE b.id = buyer_id AND b.org_id = fn_current_org())) for buyer_id, product_id, packaging_type_id, inquiry_id and quotation_id, or use composite (org_id, id) FKs. Dev-1: inquiries and follow_ups. Dev-2: samples, quotations, quotation_items. Add one cross-org insert test per file.

findings.problem: The inquiry '+ New buyer' creates a buyer row at once, an undocumented deviation from screens.md 5. For a non-+91 phone the row gets buyer_type export_importer and USD but country ''. quotes/helpers.ts treats '' as export while orders/helpers.ts isExportCountry treats it as India, so the order defaults to Truck, WhatsApp texts in the user's language instead of English, and a TAX INVOICE layout for a USD order. The buyer, contact and inquiry inserts are not atomic: a failure leaves an orphan buyer, and a retry duplicates it. This shows in the demo's 'Add one inquiry yourself' step.
findings.fix: Dev-1: store a real country (from the phone's country code, or require the Country chip), and either document the buyer-first deviation or follow screens.md 5. Dev-3: make isExportCountry agree with the quotes rule, preferably by deciding on buyer_type export_*.

findings.problem: follow_ups_delete and samples_delete check the module only. Sales can DELETE the system reminder 'Balance $18,900 due' and the approved sample SMP-0001 through PostgREST (1 row each). No screen does this.
findings.fix: follow_ups: allow DELETE only of plain notes (due_on IS NULL) created by the caller, or revoke DELETE. samples: allow DELETE only WHERE status = 'to_send'.

findings.problem: wa.dispatched says 'was dispatched today', but the order's Share on WhatsApp shows it on any later day. ORD-0002, dispatched at T-6, would say 'today'. flows.md T5 uses 'dispatched on {date}'.
findings.fix: Add {date} to the en and gu templates and pass formatDate(dispatched_on).

findings.problem: '+ Add note' uses size='sm' (h-10 = 42.5 px) in a section header on every detail page. components.md 3 allows sm only inside list rows of at least 64 px.
The receipt view and receipt print are not built (/payments/<id> gives 404). Once the success screen is closed, a receipt cannot be reopened, reprinted or re-shared.
findings.fix: Build both routes, or record the de-scope in contracts.md and tasks/todo.md.

findings.problem: screens.md 16A/16B show a date under each step and on 'Packing started'. The stepper shows only 'since status_changed_at', and a packing-card done line loses its date once the next step is reached.
findings.fix: Store per-step timestamps set by the order functions, or read them through a definer view over audit_log.

findings.problem: Money received prefills the full due. For an order whose advance is still waiting (ORD-0004: due $28,560, advance $8,568), the 2-tap path records the whole order as paid. The over-payment check cannot catch it because the amount equals the due.
findings.fix: When advance_ok is false, prefill advance_expected - received and show the full due as a hint.

findings.problem: v_followups_today returns 01, 02, 04, 03, 05 (Rhine before Al-Barakah) by contract ORDER BY due_on, created_at. sample-data.md 7 and demo-script 0:10 list 03 before 04.
findings.fix: The designers align sample-data created_at values or the script wording; no code change.

findings.problem: The checklist row order follows labels.md 9 (COA 6th), while screens.md 18 shows COA 3rd. The two design docs disagree.
findings.fix: Pick one order in the design docs.

findings.problem: 'Save & mark sent' is an insert followed by an RPC. If the RPC fails, a retry creates a second sample (already Dev-2's open issue).
findings.fix: Optionally use one definer call with a p_mark_sent flag in Sprint C.
